scope: Read-only code/metadata review. No company data read, no package run, no privacy architecture expansion.

findings.problem: Final receipt and wave manifest are independently accepted; no exact latest.output_hashes master binding, no metadata snapshot or after-run identity check.
findings.fix: Bind master relative path/hash to exact final receipt output list and current V085/wave producer metadata; snapshot receipt and wave manifest bytes/hash before reading, then require unchanged metadata and master after packaging. Reject duplicate/conflicting master entries or missing final success marker.
findings.reason: Prevent a stale or unrelated passed receipt from authorizing old master bytes.

findings.priority: required for stated checked metadata package
findings.problem: Manifest pins only Parquet pieces. Loader does not verify dictionary, value labels, missing-letter sidecar or exclusion metadata, although those files carry retained Stata meanings and privacy provenance.
findings.fix: Add exact hashes/bytes for dictionary.csv, value-labels.json, stata-missing-codes.json, excluded-columns.json and loader code; loader verifies those required metadata files before returning data. Keep metadata checksum list separate from manifest itself to avoid a self-hash.
findings.reason: A numerically valid table with altered missing codes or labels is not the claimed exact checked package.

not_findings: Parquet storage chunks are properly concatenated before analysis; no annual/raw bypass is present.
Economic numeric values are not intentionally rounded/noised. The only numeric columns intentionally denied are source/linkage keys, as explicitly listed.
Extended Stata missing-letter information is kept in a sidecar and README accurately explains loader returns numeric nulls; restoration into Stata is not claimed.
Direct-field suppression explicitly does not claim anonymity; remaining geography/industry/economic combinations are disclosed.
deferred_until_actual_run: Actual schema interface fields storage/label/display_format/value_label must match certified producer schema.
Real master row/column checks, retained exact values, all parts, sidecar code locations and fresh loader run remain execution gates.
